name: Maria Dorothea Stockburger — a son Andreas Mayer baptised at Sankt Georgen in September 1812
researcher_question: What children did Maria Dorothea Stockburger, wife of Johann Georg Meyer and mother of Magdalena (born 5 March 1817) and Anna Maria (born 9 November 1821), both baptised at Sankt Georgen im Schwarzwald, Baden, have besides these two?
